Functions.Original:
static int
equalp(
  DdHalfWord var1a,
  short phase1a,
  DdHalfWord var1b,
  short phase1b,
  DdHalfWord var2a,
  short phase2a,
  DdHalfWord var2b,
  short phase2b)
{
    return(var1a == var2a && phase1a == phase2a &&
           var1b == var2b && phase1b == phase2b);

}

Functions.Name: beforep
Functions.Original:
static int
beforep(
  DdHalfWord var1a,
  short phase1a,
  DdHalfWord var1b,
  short phase1b,
  DdHalfWord var2a,
  short phase2a,
  DdHalfWord var2b,
  short phase2b)
{
    return(var1a > var2a || (var1a == var2a &&
           (phase1a < phase2a || (phase1a == phase2a &&
            (var1b > var2b || (var1b == var2b && phase1b < phase2b))))));

}

Functions.Original:
static int
impliedp(
  DdHalfWord var1,
  short phase1,
  DdHalfWord var2,
  short phase2,
  BitVector *olv,
  BitVector *olp)
{
    return((bitVectorRead(olv, var1) &&
            bitVectorRead(olp, var1) == phase1) ||
           (bitVectorRead(olv, var2) &&
            bitVectorRead(olp, var2) == phase2));

}
